root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `parse_if_modified_since()` calls `lwan_parse_rfc_time()`, the `If-Modified-Since` raw header length must match the full 29-byte RFC1123 form `Wed, 17 Apr 2019 13:59:27 GMT`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original rejects only `raw.len == 0`, so the witnessed 17-byte `If-Modified-Since` value still reaches `lwan_parse_rfc_time()`. The fixed original restores the missing exact-length guard and only calls the parser when `helper->if_modified_since.raw.len` matches the full RFC1123 width.

nodes.state: At the final `STRING_SWITCH(str)` GMT probe, the 4-byte read extent `str + sizeof(int32_t)` lies past the original request-buffer end that bounded the short `If-Modified-Since` header.

edges.relation: The final GMT probe in `lwan_parse_rfc_time()` attempts a 4-byte read whose end lies past the same request-buffer bound that still contains the short `If-Modified-Since` value at `parse_if_modified_since()`.
The same `helper->if_modified_since.raw.value` pointer accepted at the missing length guard is forwarded unchanged into `lwan_parse_rfc_time()`.
The `raw.value` pointer passed at the vulnerable `lwan_parse_rfc_time()` call is the same base pointer later used by the final GMT probe that issues the crashing 4-byte read.
